eligibility_summary: SC category student with Delhi domicile. Enrolled in post-matric studies in recognized university/institute. Annual family income <= ₹2,50,000.
application_instructions: Apply via Delhi e-District Portal / National Scholarship Portal with Delhi SC certificate and fee receipt.
eligibility_source_citation: Govt of NCT of Delhi SC Welfare Department Post-Matric Guidelines

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships 2026–27
description: Prestigious philanthropic scholarship supporting 5,000 meritorious undergraduate students across all streams throughout their degree, with special priority for girls and specially-abled students.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹2,00,000 total grant over the entire duration of undergraduate study (up to ₹50,000 per annum).
eligibility_summary: 1st year regular full-time UG student in any stream. Minimum 60% in Class 12. Household income <= ₹15,00,000 (preference < ₹2,50,000). Mandatory online Aptitude Test.
application_instructions: Submit application on Reliance Foundation scholarships portal and appear for mandatory online Aptitude Test.
eligibility_source_citation: Reliance Foundation UG Scholarship Announcement AY 2026-27
